root_cause.text: The Verisilicon VPU driver incorrectly marked `imx8mq_vpu_shared_resources` in `drivers/media/platform/verisilicon/imx8m_vpu_hw.c` as `__initconst`, even though it is referenced later from non-init probe path data (`shared_devices` in variant structures), so module probing dereferenced freed init memory and faulted.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `static const struct of_device_id imx8mq_vpu_shared_resources[] __initconst = {` to remove `__initconst`, and the CVE text says that when built as a module this data is “freed after module init, but it's later accessed during probe, causing a page fault” and that it is “referenced from non-init code.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Keep the IMX8MQ VPU shared resource device-match table available beyond init time to avoid invalid post-init access.
intent_record.what: The `imx8mq_vpu_shared_resources` device-tree match table had its `__initconst` annotation removed, changing it from `static const struct of_device_id ... __initconst` to `static const struct of_device_id ...`.
intent_record.how: The table is no longer placed in the init-only memory section, so it remains available after kernel initialization instead of being eligible for freeing/discarding early in boot. This prevents later code from referencing memory that would have been treated as init-only.

grouping_result.intent: Keep the IMX8MQ VPU shared resource device-match table available beyond init time to avoid invalid post-init access.

relevance_review.reason: The change matches the root cause exactly: it keeps the IMX8MQ VPU shared resource table from being init-only so later probe-time references do not access freed memory.

candidates.rationale: Marking this device-match table as __initconst places it in init-only memory, but it is later referenced from non-init probe data, so after init the driver can dereference freed memory and fault.

vuln_statements.explanation: This declaration places the shared resource match table in init-only memory via __initconst. Because it is later referenced by non-init probe data, the pointer can outlive init and dereference freed memory, matching the root cause.
